calculate_mse: calculate the mean squared error between two PyTorch tensors by passing their difference
calculate_psnr: calculate the peak signal-to-noise ratio from a given mean squared error value
render_img: render a single NeRF image with inference and save outputs including depth maps
render_all_imgs: render all images in a dataset and save them with estimated depth and PSNR metrics
render_video: render a video from camera view cells and save as MP4 using imageio
